brief.goal: Add full CRUD capabilities to the task list UI: inline editing, add task, delete with confirmation, TickTick integration display, and email-to-task conversion.
constraints: Task adapter pattern already exists (GoogleTasksApi, TickTickAdapter implement TaskAdapter)
IPC handlers for create/update/delete already exist for both Google Tasks and TickTick
Preload already exposes googleTasks and ticktick CRUD methods
Zod validation on all IPC payloads
Issue #31 acceptance criteria: add/edit/delete tasks, show both Google+TickTick, email-to-task, optimistic UI, error toasts
nonGoals: Do NOT implement the TickTick adapter itself (issue #11 already done)
Do NOT implement the Google Tasks adapter itself (issue #8 already done)
Do NOT change the backend sync logic
Do NOT add new database tables
successCriteria: User can add a new task via '+' button with title, optional due date, and list selector
User can edit task title inline (click to edit) and save/cancel
User can delete task with confirmation dialog
Both Google Tasks and TickTick tasks are displayed (unified or sectioned view)
User can convert an email to a task with one click
Optimistic UI updates (no loading spinner for small actions)
Error handling shows toast/alert on failure
All existing tests continue to pass

steps.prompt: Write a feature specification for the task CRUD goal below. The issue body already contains detailed implementation requirements — synthesize them into a formal spec with measurable success criteria. Reference the existing codebase patterns.
Implement the next pending task from the spec. Follow test-driven practices. Start with the core TaskList UI changes (add/edit/delete), then TickTick display, then email-to-task conversion.
Review the implementation against the specification and success criteria. Verify independently — you are the checker, not the maker.

specify.output: Created specs/007-task-crud/spec.md with formal feature specification including requirements, UI changes, IPC additions, data flow, error handling matrix, testing strategy, and DoD.

implement.output: Implemented full CRUD: new tasks-handlers.ts IPC with Zod, preload allowlist updated, TaskList overhauled (add/edit/delete/unified Google+TickTick), EmailList convert-to-task added. 18 new tests pass, typecheck and lint clean.

converge.output: All 18 acceptance criteria verified PASS. No non-goals violations. 197/303 tests pass (106 pre-existing sqlite failures unrelated). Typecheck and lint clean. Quality: 18/18 (100%).
